recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下可見核摺疊的單核球、前單核球與各階段顆粒球（桿狀核、分葉核、中幼粒細胞）混合存在，並有有核紅血球；單核球與顆粒球共同增生而非母細胞成片，符合幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）。
features: Monocytes and promonocytes with folded, convoluted nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Granulocytic maturation present: myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Occasional cells with ring-shaped or doughnut nuclei
Orthochromatic erythroid precursors with dense pyknotic nuclei
Scattered larger cells with finer chromatin but no sheets of blasts
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a mixed population of monocytes and promonocytes with folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, admixed with maturing granulocytes including myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Scattered late erythroid precursors are present. Blasts are identified but do not form sheets in this field. Findings are consistent with a myelomonocytic proliferation compatible with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AMML requires at least 20% blasts including promonocytes, whereas JMML shows predominant maturing myelomonocytic cells with blasts below 20%.
CMML has overlapping marrow morphology but occurs in older adults and lacks the childhood RAS-pathway (PTPN11, NRAS, KRAS, NF1, CBL) genetic context.
Pediatric MDS is usually hypocellular without prominent monocytic proliferation or peripheral monocytosis.
